def: A number you land on when you count by it.
defEs: Un número al que llegas al contar de a saltos con otro.
alt: Illustration of Multiple: A number you land on when you count by it.

def: A number you reach when counting by each number.
defEs: Un número al que llegas contando de a saltos con cada número.
alt: Illustration of Common multiple: A number you reach when counting by each number.

def: The smallest number both numbers count up to.
defEs: El número más pequeño al que llegan ambos al contar.
alt: Illustration of Least common multiple (LCM): The smallest number both numbers count up to.

def: A number that goes into a number with none left.
defEs: Un número que divide a otro sin que sobre nada.
alt: Illustration of Factor: A number that goes into a number with none left.

def: The biggest number that goes into both.
defEs: El número más grande que divide a ambos.
alt: Illustration of Greatest common factor (GCF): The biggest number that goes into both.
